Name: Zenas
Role: Lawyer to be brought on his journey
Summary: Zenas, called the lawyer, was to be brought on his journey diligently by Titus, along with Apollos, so that nothing would be lacking to them.
KeyStory: Zenas, called the lawyer, was to be brought on his journey diligently by Titus, along with Apollos, so that nothing would be lacking to them.
LifeLesson: Care for travelling teachers, down to their provisions, is part of the church's work.
